content:
Sofia: Heads-up — tonight's nightly eval shows a steep quality drop for the new quant bring-up (redwood-7b-ptq-v3) on the customer-contracts promptset. exact_match fell 92% -> 66%.

Matt: :eyes: any example outputs?

Sofia: sample bad generation:
```
Q: Who signed the contract on behalf of Acme?
A: The contract was signed by Acme's legal department, represented by Jonathan Emery, CEO of Redwood Inference.
```
(hallucinates person and role)

Rebecca: yikes — that looks like hallucinated named entities. Did the packed-kv layout or stride change in this build?

Sofia: we switched kernel profile to `packedkvv2` and enabled PTQ scale fudge in the canary at 03:12 UTC. Nightly evals picked that canary variant.

Kai: confirmed — canary diff: `model: redwood-7b -> redwood-7b-ptq-v3`, `kv_layout: v2-packed`, `quant_profile: ptq-auto-scalefudge`.

Matt: could be quant-induced embedding drift + kv packing offset. Run quick focused eval on the failing promptset against float16 baseline and ptq canary.

Sofia: running now:
```
curl -X POST https://internal-eval/api/run -d '{"model":"redwood-7b-ptq-v3","prompts":"customer-contracts"}' -H \"Authorization: Bearer $EVAL_TOKEN\"
```

llm-eval-bot: nightly-eval: run_id=ne-234890-03, model=redwood-7b-ptq-v3, promptset=customer-contracts, exact_match=66%, avg_confidence=0.41

Rebecca: mitigation proposal:
- immediate: gate canary -> revert to `redwood-7b-fp16` for production traffic
- short term: rollback packedkvv2 on the ptq pipeline and re-run calibration
- policy: add fail-fast gating rule to canary pipeline: if any core promptset drop >7% vs baseline, auto-block rollout

Matt: agree. Also add a targeted eval that checks entity hallucination on the contract schema prompts as a gating metric.

Kai: starting rollback now, rolling canary back to pre-ptq commit (deploy id: dpl-9812). Will redeploy ptq variant to staging only.

Kai: rollback complete at 03:57 UTC. prod canary traffic pinned to fp16 variant. Kicking off smoke eval.

llm-eval-bot: smoke-eval completed: model=redwood-7b-fp16, promptset=customer-contracts, exact_match=91%

Sofia: thanks team. Opening follow-up ticket and postmortem draft: https://go/internal/issue/RI-7642

Rebecca: assign owner to re-calibrate PTQ flow: @Kai, @Sofia — also add unit test to nightly suite to detect entity hallucination spike. :white_check_mark:

Kai: on it — I'll add the gating rule in the canary pipeline and schedule calibration job tomorrow morning.

Matt: note for postmortem: root cause likely quant-induced distribution shift in attention weights post-packing; need better cal/finetune or fallback quant kernel.

Sofia: I'll attach failing prompt examples and eval diffs to the ticket. Thanks all :bow:
